scripts.// === Git & Deployment ===: Repository helpers. Review git status before committing or pushing.
scripts.git:push:all: git remote set-url origin https://github.com/Trustlink-Labs/TSN-Protocol.git && git push -u origin HEAD:main --force-with-lease
scripts.git:commit:push:all: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); const run = (cmd, args) => { const r = spawnSync(cmd, args, { stdio: 'inherit' }); if (r.status !== 0) process.exit(r.status || 1); }; run('git', ['remote', 'set-url', 'origin', 'https://github.com/Trustlink-Labs/TSN-Protocol.git']); run('git', ['add', '-A']); const diff = spawnSync('git', ['diff', '--cached', '--name-only']); const hasChanges = (diff.stdout || '').toString().trim().length > 0; if (!hasChanges) { console.log('No changes to commit; pushing current HEAD to TSN remote.'); } else { run('git', ['commit', '-m', 'Something just got updated!']); } run('git', ['push', '-u', 'origin', 'HEAD:main', '--force-with-lease']);"
